usage.callShape: GET https://netintel-production-440c.up.railway.app/asn-lookup/analyze?target=<ip-or-domain> (x402, USDC on Base; target passed as query param)
usage.outputShape: body.score (0-100), body.grade, body.classification, body.findings[] {rule,deduction,detail}; plus geo/ASN fields body.asn, body.asn_number, body.organization, body.country, body.region, body.city, body.hostname, body.is_hosting, body.is_cloud, body.is_vpn
quirks: target is a QUERY PARAM on a GET request (no JSON body): ?target=<ip-or-domain>
Accepts both IPv4/IPv6 addresses and domain names as target
usage.guide: Call GET https://netintel-production-440c.up.railway.app/asn-lookup/analyze with a single query param target set to an IP address (v4 or v6) or a domain name, e.g. ?target=8.8.8.8. Pay via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.001/call). The JSON response is returned synchronously: read body.score (0-100), body.grade and body.classification for reputation, and body.findings[] for the specific risk signals. ASN/geo enrichment (organization, country, is_vpn, is_cloud, is_hosting) is in the same flat object.
